styles.Notes: Anything outside the site boundary. Sets colour only, so each run keeps the width, dash and zoom band of whatever it is.
On-site substation. Circuits feed back to it and it connects on to the POC.
Where the network meets the DNO's. One per utility.
LV link box. Sits on the network between substation and circuits.
Size and shape only. Fill comes from the plot's bedroom count and is not overridden here.
Numbered points along a circuit. Seq 0 sits on the substation.
Where one circuit's cable ends or forks. Drawn in the circuit's own colour; this colour is the fallback.
Multi service distribution board. One cable in, one out; the flats it feeds are a table on the board rather than points on the drawing.
Where a plot's supplies enter it. Drawn from Boundary_At on the plot seed rather than from a feature of its own. Symbol_Size_Px is the radius of the ring, Min_Scale the zoom it appears at.
